item.text:
**7B.8 Research Note**

Verdict: **mixed, leaning negative**. In 2024 AMLO did honor some formal commitments, especially the transition and exit from office, and there are a few concrete enforcement / accountability episodes. But the stronger evidence shows repeated strategic framing, hostility toward scrutiny, and major institutional changes that critics saw as reducing independent checks.

**Evidence For**
- [Presidente López Obrador y virtual presidenta electa Sheinbaum alistan transición y reformas para continuar la 4T](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-lopez-obrador-y-virtual-presidenta-electa-sheinbaum-alistan-transicion-y-reformas-para-continuar-la-4t/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-10. AMLO publicly committed to a formal transition with Sheinbaum; this is real evidence that he respected the handoff rather than treating office as personal property. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.5`
- [AMLO asegura que no habrá "retrocesos" en México con Claudia Sheinbaum](https://www.nmas.com.mx/nacional/politica/amlo-asegura-que-no-habra-retrocesos-en-mexico-con-claudia-sheinbaum/) — N+, 2024-06-16. He said there would be no rollback and that the transition was secured, which is at least consistent with honoring a formal succession commitment. QIDs: `7B.8`
- [Presentan resultados de elecciones en conferencia del presidente: “Se requiere garantizar el derecho a la información”, afirma](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presentan-resultados-de-elecciones-en-conferencia-del-presidente-se-requiere-garantizar-el-derecho-a-la-informacion-afirma/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-05. He presented the preliminary election result as public information rather than denial or instability; later he also accepted the tribunal-validated outcome. QIDs: `7B.8`
- [20-06-24 versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-20. AMLO said a vote-by-vote recount was the best way to remove suspicion and said citizens should respect the electoral authority’s decision. QIDs: `7B.8`
- [25-06-24 versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-25. He said he would not seek reelection and would leave office; that commitment was not reversed. QIDs: `7B.8`
- [Presidente alista carpeta de información para familiares de 43 normalistas de Ayotzinapa](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-alista-carpeta-de-informacion-para-familiares-de-43-normalistas-de-ayotzinapa/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-07-04. The government said it had searched 251 sites and was still working the Ayotzinapa case with families, which is limited evidence against a simple closure-by-denial story. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.7`
- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-03-15. AMLO’s government publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected firm, which cuts against a blanket pattern of protecting insiders. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.7`, `7B.4`
- [AMLO acepta represión violenta en Veracruz](https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html) — El Economista, 2024-07-16. He acknowledged police violence against protesters and said two officers were detained, which is one of the clearer 2024 examples of admitting state misconduct rather than concealing it. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.7`
- [Mexican finance minister seeks to soothe investors, reduce public debt](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexican-finance-minister-seeks-to-soothe-investors-reduce-public-debt-3470241) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04. Ramírez de la O stayed on, emphasized fiscal discipline, central bank autonomy, rule of law, and investor communication; this is limited but real evidence of technocratic continuity rather than pure improvisation. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.5`
- [Entrega directa de programas para el Bienestar abate la corrupción](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/) — Programas para el Bienestar, 2024-10-17. The government said direct deposits to Banco del Bienestar cards eliminated intermediaries and commissions, which is an anti-patronage delivery design rather than a hidden-take system. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.5`

**Evidence Against**
- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04. Reuters reported that AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and pushed an overhaul critics saw as a way to cement Morena’s hegemony and weaken contestable power. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`
- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) — Reuters, 2024-09-15. The reform was sold as serving ordinary citizens, but critics said it weakened judicial independence and investor confidence, making it harder to check executive misconduct and hidden tradeoffs. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.7`
- [Analysis-Mexico's judicial reform stokes investor fears, though some analysts bullish](https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/analysismexicos-judicial-reform-stokes-investor-fears-though-some-analysts-bullish-3618899) — Reuters, 2024-09-17. Reuters said the reform increased uncertainty over rule of law and institutions, which is consistent with opportunistic institutional change rather than stable commitment. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.7`
- [Mexico | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico) — Reuters Institute, 2024-06-17. The overview says Gálvez won a court-ordered right of reply to false claims by AMLO, and that his final year featured regular attacks on journalists and the media. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`
- [Mexicos? president lambastes YouTube after company edits video revealing NYT journalists' number](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-president-lambastes-youtube-after-company-edits-video-revealing-nyt-journalists-number-3314584) — Reuters, 2024-02-26. AMLO publicly revealed a New York Times journalist’s phone number and defended the move, which looks like intimidation rather than correction. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`
- [Mexico | Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024) — Freedom House, 2024. Freedom House reported a covert military cyberspace unit monitoring critics and broader surveillance with little oversight, which supports a pattern of manipulating public information and punishing scrutiny. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`
- [Mexico | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) — Human Rights Watch, 2024. HRW said AMLO and his party blocked INAI appointments, leaving the transparency body unable to function normally; that weakens independent correction and public access to information. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`
- [Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) — Programas para el Bienestar, 2024-03-18. The government said January-February payments were advanced before the blackout, which makes the timing look electorally strategic and patronage-sensitive. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.5`
- [Economía de México es sólida y hay responsabilidad en manejo de finanzas](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-de-mexico-es-solida-y-hay-responsabilidad-en-manejo-de-finanzas-presidente/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-04. AMLO dismissed market concern as alarmism and insisted policy would not change because it had already worked; this reads more like deflection than transparent acknowledgment of tradeoffs. QIDs: `7B.8`
- [HRW proposed constitutional changes threaten rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) — Human Rights Watch, 2024-08-30. HRW warned the package could weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy/transparency safeguards, making concealed conduct harder to expose. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`

**Search gap**
- I found strong evidence on specific 2024 episodes, but not a comprehensive third-party audit of all campaign promises or a formal promise-tracking dataset for AMLO in 2024.
- The strongest positive items are mostly official government statements or discrete procedural episodes; the strongest negative items are more independent and more systemic.
